question:
How many triangles are in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6bc936b1bee0a7488fbdaf22af03327283481b77f58dfe689121a94316fd33.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the triangle in the given figure is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d5d3f0f9d6c424b7ebe8e0524fbee0cf1866a9ca866c3f7914773c1af98ce4e.png] 

Total triangles = Number of parts × Number of diagonals

= 6 × 2 ⇒ **12**

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
